answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Single-use capability token with expiry flips the bet — a token that dies after one use or one hour — and the comet lands on the attacker instead. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the meadow of that gap is the whole defence in one line. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The ferrous grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
